hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$f" in */node_modules/*) ;; *.ts|*.tsx) (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && node_modules/.bin/oxfmt "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1) ;; *.css) (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && node_modules/.bin/stylelint --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; node_modules/.bin/oxfmt "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1) ;; esac; exit 0
